description: Divides a phasor into equal steps and applies a shaping algorithm inside each step, for step-by-step sequence warping or phase distortion

params.text: Sets how many equal steps the phasor cycle is cut into, 1 to 64, snapped to whole numbers
Attenuverter scaling the Steps CV input, with a full 5V sweeping the whole 1 to 64 range
Sets the depth of the shaping applied within each step, negative one way and positive the other, with no change at centre
Attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the Shape CV input before it is added to the Shape knob
Picks the shaping algorithm: Curve, S-Curve, Split, Swing, Shift, Triangle, Arc, Speed - Clip, Speed - Wrap and Speed - Fold; a lamp beside the list marks the one in use
Attenuverter scaling the Mode CV input, which steps through all ten algorithms across 5V

inputs.text: The phasor being shaped, 0-10V; voltages outside that range wrap back into it
Modulates the number of steps, added to the Steps knob
Modulates the shaping depth, added to the Shape knob
Modulates which shaping algorithm is used, added to the Mode knob
Shaping is applied only while this is at 1V or above; below that the phasor passes through untouched. With nothing patched here, shaping is always applied

outputs.text: The whole phasor with every one of its steps shaped, 0-10V
The shaped ramp of the current step on its own, covering 0-10V within each step and restarting at every step boundary

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
